tool.name: InputProcessing
tool.description: : Wrapper of the Input processing steps from MDDB workflow module.

param.name: input_topology_filepath
param.label: input PDB,GRO,PRMTOP,TOP,ITP,TPR,PSF file
param.help: Input topology or structure file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_topology_filepath
param.label: output PRMTOP,TOP,TPR,PSF name
param.help: Output topology file, with a filtered set of atoms matching the trajectory Format: [output].[format]

param.name: outname_output_trajectory_filepath
param.label: output XTC name
param.help: Output XTC trajectory file with the filtered, imaged and fitted coordinates Format: [output].xtc

param.name: outname_output_structure_filepath
param.label: output CIF name
param.help: Output mmCIF structure file with the filtered, imaged and fitted coordinates Format: [output].cif

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: filter
param.label: filter
param.help: Removed atoms from the system. A custom atom selection may be passed using VMD selection syntax. Pass the label 'def' to remove water and counter ions by default

param.name: image
param.label: image
param.help: Set if the workflow must attempt to automatically image the system (remove Periodic Boundary Conditions where pertinent). WARNING: This is a simple default imaging protocol and may fail in many cases.

param.name: fit
param.label: fit
param.help: Set if the workflow must attempt to automatically fit the system (remove rotation and translation where pertinent).

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the MDDB workflow executable binary.
